items.name: Acceltra
items.description: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.

items.name: Acceltra Prime
items.description: Engage your enemies with deadly speed. This weapon reloads even faster when its wielder sprints, faster still with Gauss.

items.name: Aeolak
items.description: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.

items.name: Afentis
items.description: Styanax's speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.

items.name: Afentis Prime
items.description: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.

items.name: Alternox
items.description: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.

items.name: Alternox Prime
items.description: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.

items.name: Ambassador
items.description: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.

items.name: Amprex
items.description: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.

items.name: Arca Plasmor
items.description: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.

items.name: Argonak
items.description: Pick off targets by highlighting distant enemies using this Grineer rifle's advanced laser sighting system. Deadly in both single fire and automatic modes.

items.name: Astilla
items.description: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.

items.name: Astilla Prime
items.description: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.

items.name: Attica
items.description: Quickly fire off a volley of deadly bolts with the Attica repeating crossbow.

items.name: Ax-52
items.description: This pre-Orokin weapon earned its popularity for its reliability in tough conditions. When hip-firing, its Ammo Efficiency increases. When aiming, headshots have a high Critical Chance.

items.name: Basmu
items.description: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.

items.name: Battacor
items.description: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.

items.name: Baza
items.description: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.

items.name: Baza Prime
items.description: This rapid-fire classic is the Orokin-engineered definition of silent, pinpoint lethality.

items.name: Boar
items.description: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.

items.name: Boar Prime
items.description: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.

items.name: Boltor
items.description: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

items.name: Boltor Prime
items.description: Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.

items.name: Braton
items.description: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.

items.name: Braton Prime
items.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.

items.name: Braton Vandal
items.description: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

items.name: Bubonico
items.description: Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.

items.name: Burston
items.description: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.

items.name: Burston Prime
items.description: Once thought lost to the ages, attempts to reengineer the Burston Prime never fully replicated this weapon's power and agility.

items.name: Buzlok
items.description: Mark your targets and unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked targets are more likely to take critical hits.

items.name: Carmine Penta
items.description: Enveloped in deep red composite enamel, this Penta variant features a higher fire-rate and over-sized magazine.

items.name: Cedo
items.description: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire's precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.

items.name: Cedo Prime
items.description: A golden shotgun, forged for those who deliver judgment.

items.name: Cernos
items.description: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.

items.name: Cernos Prime
items.description: A noble bow to hunt hellish beasts.

items.name: Cinta
items.description: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.

items.name: Coda Bassocyst
items.description: Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.

items.name: Coda Bubonico
items.description: With increased magazine size, the Coda Bubonico was born of the Technocyte virus' need to spread infection. Primary Fire rate ramps up with continuous fire.

items.name: Coda Hema
items.description: The Technocyte virus did nothing but increase the Hema’s thirst for blood. With increased Fire Rate, Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

items.name: Coda Sporothrix
items.description: Delivers a virus-laden barb to its victim that continues to damage it before exploding. With increased Damage, Reload Speed, Magazine Size, Status Chance, and explosion radius.

items.name: Coda Synapse
items.description: Firing a nonstop stream of vile corrosive gastric juice, the Coda Synapse comes with increased Magazine size, Beam Length, Status Chance, Punch Through, and Damage.

items.name: Convectrix
items.description: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.

items.name: Corinth
items.description: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.

items.name: Corinth Prime
items.description: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.

items.name: Daikyu
items.description: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.

items.name: Daikyu Prime
items.description: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.

items.name: Dera
items.description: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.

items.name: Dera Vandal
items.description: A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.

items.name: Dex Sybaris
items.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the third anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

items.name: Drakgoon
items.description: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

items.name: Dread
items.description: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.

items.name: Efv-5 Jupiter
items.description: Perforate Techrot, and anyone else who stands in your way, with this Scaldra machine gun. Alternative fire pummels targets with Efervon laced buckshot.

items.name: Enkaus
items.description: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.

items.name: Evensong
items.description:
Counter the dread of battle with a song of praise. Enemies cannot hurt your allies while wounded by Evensong's arrows. Kills with Evensong empower ally weapons with Multishot.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

items.name: Exergis
items.description: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.

items.name: Felarx
items.description: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.

items.name: Ferrox
items.description: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.

items.name: Flux Rifle
items.description: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.

items.name: Fulmin
items.description: Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.

items.name: Fulmin Prime
items.description: Wield a storm. Fulmin Prime's electric rounds switch between lightning beams and short-range bursts. Wisp quickly swaps between each mode with her elemental prowess.

items.name: Glaxion
items.description: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.

items.name: Glaxion Vandal
items.description: A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.

items.name: Gorgon
items.description: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.

items.name: Gorgon Wraith
items.description: The Gorgon Wraith is a powerful variant of its precursor that features unique styling.

items.name: Gotva Prime
items.description: Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect, its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.

items.name: Grakata
items.description: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.

items.name: Grinlok
items.description: With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.

items.name: Haalvu
items.description: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.

items.name: Harpak
items.description: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.

items.name: Hek
items.description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.

items.name: Hema
items.description: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.

items.name: Higasa
items.description: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.

items.name: Hind
items.description: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.

items.name: Ignis
items.description: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.

items.name: Ignis Wraith
items.description: A blood-red variant of this destructive flamethrower.

items.name: Javlok
items.description: Launch super-heated slugs at individual foes, or hurl the entire weapon and ignite groups of enemies in a flash inferno.

items.name: Karak
items.description: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.

items.name: Karak Wraith
items.description: A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.

items.name: Kohm
items.description: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

items.name: Komorex
items.description: Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.

items.name: Kuva Bramma
items.description: This Grineer bow delivers vengeance in the form of clusterbomb-tipped arrows that can be detonated mid-air or on impact. Low quiver capacity, arrows are recovered singly.

items.name: Kuva Chakkhurr
items.description: Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.

items.name: Kuva Drakgoon
items.description: The Kuva Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room that do not slow down. Larger Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

items.name: Kuva Hek
items.description: Forged at the behest of the Worm Queen herself, this already powerful shotgun now has the additional ability to fire from all four barrels simultaneously.

items.name: Kuva Hind
items.description: This powerful Grineer burst rifle has been retrofitted to add semi-automatic and automatic fire modes.

items.name: Kuva Karak
items.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. It has greater reload speed, lower recoil and greater accuracy than the standard-issue Karak rifle.

items.name: Kuva Kohm
items.description: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

items.name: Kuva Ogris
items.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. Unlike the basic version the Kuva Ogris fires detonite-infused casings semi-automatically, from a smaller magazine, while dealing greater damage per shot.

items.name: Kuva Quartakk
items.description: Unlike a standard Quartakk this Kuva Lich variant fires automatically from the hip while retaining its signature feature when aimed: annihilating targets with four simultaneous shots.

items.name: Kuva Sobek
items.description: The Kuva Sobek's exceptional Reload Speed, Critical Chance, and Status Chance make it a natural fit for the Kuva Lich's dominant spirit.

items.name: Kuva Tonkor
items.description: This Lich-variant grenade launcher hurls mayhem and destruction with an increased Reload Speed.

items.name: Kuva Zarr
items.description: An even stronger Zarr cannon to meet the demands of Kuva Liches. With stronger explosive barrages, and long-range flak shots.

items.name: Lanka
items.description: The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.

items.name: Latron
items.description: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.

items.name: Latron Prime
items.description: The ornamental Latron Prime exploits ancient Orokin technology to get a slight damage increase over the standard Latron.

items.name: Latron Wraith
items.description: The Latron Wraith is a powerful variation of the standard, semi-automatic rifle that features unique styling.

items.name: Lenz
items.description:
Bolts from this Corpus bow deliver a one-two punch of an icy pulse, followed by a conventional explosion. Excess ammo picked up for other weapons will be converted into charges for the Lenz. 

Warning: Safety-protocols do not exist on this prototype.

items.name: Miter
items.description: The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.

items.name: Mk1-Braton
items.description: The MK1-Braton is the standard issue rifle for all Tenno. A versatile weapon that can be customized to support a wide variety of play styles.

items.name: Mk1-Paris
items.description: The MK1-Paris is the standard issue bow for all Tenno.

items.name: Mk1-Strun
items.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.

items.name: Mutalist Cernos
items.description: Overcome with Infestation, this bow's arrows now spread poisonous contagion to any surface they hit.

items.name: Mutalist Quanta
items.description: A bizarre union of Corpus technology and Infested biology, this automatic rifle can also deploy an irradiated airborne infested mass. Further field testing is required to fully understand the potential of this weapon.

items.name: Nagantaka
items.description: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.

items.name: Nagantaka Prime
items.description: A golden version of Garuda's versatile crossbow, as fashioned by the Orokin's finest weaponsmiths. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshot kills have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda the Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.

items.name: Nataruk
items.description: Hunhow’s gift, carved from the bones of his kin. Shots can be charged and held; release them just before full charge for maximum effect.

items.name: Nunchasa
items.description: Narin's signature bow is the north wind's icy messenger. Alt Fire unleashes a charged blizzard arrow that freezes enemies it touches and leaves behind a chilling path.

items.name: Ogris
items.description: Ogris fires detonite-infused casings.

items.name: Opticor
items.description: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.

items.name: Opticor Vandal
items.description: With a precision crafted lens, this customized Opticor achieves a level of performance previously thought impossible.

items.name: Panthera
items.description: Firing high-velocity blades, this weapon can also be used as a battle-saw, shredding anything unfortunate enough to get within range.

items.name: Panthera Prime
items.description: The max-velocity saw-launcher perfected. Features a larger magazine, faster fire rate, and a radial, slashing ricochet.

items.name: Paracyst
items.description: Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordnance and a harpoon like appendage.

items.name: Paris
items.description: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.

items.name: Paris Prime
items.description: Discovered deep inside an ancient Orokin derelict, the Paris Prime increases the kinetic energy of any bolt it fires, dealing more damage than its more common counterpart.

items.name: Penta
items.description: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.

items.name: Perigale
items.description: Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession grant the Perigale Infinite Ammo. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.

items.name: Perigale Prime
items.description: The one who exalted Voruna to her Prime form imbued her signature sniper rifle with increased magazine size and ammo capacity, as if to arm her for a long hunt.

items.name: Phage
items.description: Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life of any surface they contact.

items.name: Phantasma
items.description: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.

items.name: Phantasma Prime
items.description: Phantasma Prime is burnished with deadly force. In Revenant’s hands, it has increased magazine capacity. The might of its irradiated plasma is reminiscent of the fearsome Eidolon.

items.name: Phenmor
items.description: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.

items.name: Prisma Gorgon
items.description: Adorned with void hardened prisma crystal, this Gorgon variant is prized for its beauty and enhanced mechanics.

items.name: Prisma Grakata
items.description: Encased in plates refined from pure prisma crystals, this rare element gives this assault rifle a radiant luster.

items.name: Prisma Grinlok
items.description: Prisma-crystal enhancement creates here a prestige instrument; a weapon capable of taking life at astonishing range with but a single pull of its exquisitely-tooled trigger.

items.name: Prisma Lenz
items.description: The explosive potential of the Lenz, enhanced with Prisma crystals.

items.name: Prisma Tetra
items.description: When bathed in Void energy and prisma crystal, the simple Tetra becomes a beacon of style and intimidation.

items.name: Proboscis Cernos
items.description: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.

items.name: Purgator 1
items.description: Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.

items.name: Quanta
items.description: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.

items.name: Quanta Vandal
items.description: A customized version of the Quanta, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

items.name: Quartakk
items.description: Annihilate targets with four simultaneous shots from this high-caliber Grineer rifle.

items.name: Quellor
items.description: The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.

items.name: Rakta Cernos
items.description: A finely tuned instrument of assassination.

items.name: Rauta
items.description: Kullervo's signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.

items.name: Reconifex
items.description: Cyte-09's signature rifle is an ideal match for forceful gunners. A precisely timed reload increases reload speed and infuses the new magazine with Heat Damage.

items.name: Rubico
items.description: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.

items.name: Rubico Prime
items.description: For the hunter, the apex of the sniper's art. For the hunted, a gateway to the next life.

items.name: Sancti Tigris
items.description: Echo nature's violent beauty with this special Tigris.

items.name: Scourge
items.description: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.

items.name: Scourge Prime
items.description: Smite the unrighteous with Harrow Prime's signature speargun.

items.name: Secura Penta
items.description: Ruthless and efficient, just like the free-market.

items.name: Shedu
items.description: This arm-cannon, ripped from a Sentient, rapid-fires thermal pulses that explode in an electrical blast. Features an ammo-less quick charge capacitor, that emits a knock-back pulse and strips Sentient damage resistances when fully discharged.

items.name: Simulor
items.description: Creates miniature gravitational singularities that can be used for scientific study or self-defense.

items.name: Sirocco
items.description: A silent, pistol-style Amp for the Drifter. Generates its own ammunition from Void energy. A precisely timed reload over-charges the next shot.

items.name: Snipetron
items.description: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.

items.name: Snipetron Vandal
items.description: A customized version of the elusive Snipetron, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

items.name: Sobek
items.description: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.

items.name: Soma
items.description: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.

items.name: Soma Prime
items.description: Known for taking down whole squads with its single massive magazine, few weapons were as feared as the Prime Soma.

items.name: Sporothrix
items.description: This long-distance rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.

items.name: Stahlta
items.description: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.

items.name: Steflos
items.description: An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.

items.name: Steflos Prime
items.description: This rose has gilded thorns. Deal death from even further afar with Citrine Prime's signature shotgun.

items.name: Stradavar
items.description: A high-capacity, high-damage enforcer, this weapon can switch between the high crit semi-automatic and full automatic firing modes.

items.name: Stradavar Prime
items.description: Between measured staccato and staggering crescendo, Stradavar Prime never fails to call down a devastating finale.

items.name: Strun
items.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.

items.name: Strun Prime
items.description: A classic shotgun design, embellished for the elite as only the Orokin could.

items.name: Strun Wraith
items.description: A different take on a familiar shotgun, the Strun Wraith features unique styling.

items.name: Supra
items.description: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.

items.name: Supra Vandal
items.description: A customized version of the powerful Supra, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.

items.name: Sybaris
items.description: This Tenno crafted, lever action rifle, is equal parts elegance and executioner.

items.name: Sybaris Prime
items.description: Sleek and slender, a golden symbol of Tenno perfection.

items.name: Synapse
items.description: Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the Infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive energy.

items.name: Synoid Simulor
items.description: Cephalon Suda's custom issue Simulor was built to satisfy her curiosity.

items.name: Telos Boltor
items.description: Bring down judgement, with this boltor crafted by the Arbiters of Hexis.

items.name: Tenet Arca Plasmor
items.description: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.

items.name: Tenet Envoy
items.description: This discreet rocket launcher is equally at home in a board meeting or on a casual outing. Aimed rockets are wire-guided for greater accuracy, but travel more slowly. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the weapon when holstered.

items.name: Tenet Ferrox
items.description: The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.

items.name: Tenet Flux Rifle
items.description: Sister-modified Flux Rifle with increased fire rate and range. Recharge has been replaced with ammo clips to accommodate greater power needs.

items.name: Tenet Glaxion
items.description: Advances in microelectronics have improved a Corpus classic. Tenet Glaxion’s photon beam strikes up to four enemies at once. It also boasts superior Damage, Critical Chance, and Status Chance.

items.name: Tenet Quanta
items.description: Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta's lethality even further.

items.name: Tenet Tetra
items.description: Parvosian upgrade of the classic Tetra. Slower fire rate but with a larger magazine. Can now alt-fire entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.

items.name: Tenora
items.description: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.

items.name: Tenora Prime
items.description: Add lethal staccato percussion to Octavia's melodies with this masterpiece assault rifle.

items.name: Tetra
items.description: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.

items.name: Thornbak
items.description: A sturdy burst-rifle of considerable age and unknown origin collected by Teshin during his many years wandering the Origin System.

items.name: Tiberon
items.description: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.

items.name: Tiberon Prime
items.description: Art meets ingenuity with this beautifully deadly rifle.

items.name: Tigris
items.description: The double-barreled Tigris shotgun fires two bursts in rapid succession, easily taking down the toughest prey.

items.name: Tigris Prime
items.description: An artifact of exquisite beauty. A weapon of deadly purpose.

items.name: Tonkor
items.description: Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.

items.name: Torid
items.description: Torid lobs a toxic payload.

items.name: Trumna
items.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy, oversized automatic rifle with withering fire that delivers rapid heat damage. Secondary fire unleashes an arcing projectile that ricochets off surfaces and enemies, exploding on every impact.

items.name: Trumna Prime
items.description: Sleek lines and golden accents define this masterpiece of the illustrious Entrati family.

items.name: Vadarya Prime
items.description: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.

items.name: Vaykor Hek
items.description: Forged in the fires of rebel struggle, this shotgun is a force for liberation.

items.name: Vectis
items.description: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.

items.name: Vectis Prime
items.description: Once thought destroyed, the newly uncovered Vectis Prime revives Tenno martial traditions.

items.name: Veldt
items.description: Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.

items.name: Vinquibus
items.description: Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.

items.name: Vulkar
items.description: Built by the Grineer for their elite troopers, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.

items.name: Vulkar Wraith
items.description: A blood-red variant of this devastating sniper rifle.

items.name: Zarr
items.description: Unload a barrage of explosives or a huge shot of flak from this cannon’s enormous barrel.

items.name: Zenith
items.description: Deploy the radar disc to reveal hidden enemies and then strike with precision shots that punch through all obstacles in the way.

items.name: Zhuge
items.description: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.

items.name: Zhuge Prime
items.description: Tenno artistry. Ancient craft. A weapon of surgical precision and devastating effect. Each bolt fired by Zhuge Prime explodes shortly after embedding.
